text_block_list.text:
Machikane Fukukitaru completed the Japan 
Derby, feeling thoroughly refreshed.

She breathed a sigh of relief, thinking 
the next race would be an easy one, but...

According to the fortune-telling, the next 
race to enter is the Kikuka Sho.

Faced with yet another great trial, 
Matikanefukukitaru let out a wail of 
despair.
